name: CRITICAL WARNING: Chili's Skillet Queso & Tortilla Chips (Saturated Grease Bomb)
whyItWorks: Packs 1,400+ calories of melted processed cheese food, ground beef with chili spices, and a basket of salty, hard fried corn tortilla chips. Saturated dairy fat + capsaicin + razor-sharp fried corn chips equals severe mucosal trauma.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never order Chili's Skillet Queso or fried corn tortilla chips during flares or with active strictures.
